faqs.question: Do you offer painless treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use the latest anaesthesia techniques and topical numbing gels to ensure a completely comfortable experience. Most patients report feeling nothing during their procedure.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book online via the booking section on this page, call us directly, or message us on WhatsApp. We confirm within 2 hours.

faqs.question: Do you accept dental insurance?
faqs.answer: We accept all major dental insurance plans. Our team will help you understand your coverage and maximize your benefits before treatment begins.

faqs.question: How long does a typical appointment take?
faqs.answer: A routine checkup + cleaning takes 45–60 minutes. Procedures like fillings take 30–45 minutes. We'll give you a time estimate when you book.

faqs.question: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faqs.answer: Call our emergency line immediately. We keep emergency slots open every day and will guide you on what to do while you travel to the clinic.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We have a dedicated pediatric dentist and a kids' waiting zone. We recommend first visits around age 2–3 to build good habits early.
